name: subminer
description: All-in-one sentence mining overlay with AnkiConnect and dictionary integration

scripts.test:subtitle: pnpm run build && node --test dist/subtitle/stages.test.js dist/subtitle/pipeline.test.js
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
scripts.build:mac:unsigned: pnpm run build && env -u APPLE_ID -u APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD -u APPLE_TEAM_ID -u CSC_LINK -u CSC_KEY_PASSWORD CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip
